Tildes code block style uses triple tilde fences

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"code_block_style\":\"Tildes\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<pre><code>some code</code></pre>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
